title: UI screenshot tour, architecture docs and final UI sweep
player_outcome: The whole Terraria-style UI is captured in a repeatable screenshot tour at two resolutions and two UI scales, and is documented for future work.
design:
New game/Testing/Tours/ui.cmds, run on lavapipe:
- Tiny world, stone arena.
- ui_01_hud (day, full hearts); drink 3 potions → ui_02_buffs.
- Place a work bench and wooden chest, `interact` → ui_03_chest; ui_04_crafting.
- `town summon merchant`, `ui talk merchant` → ui_05_npc_chat; `ui shop` → ui_06_shop.
- `boss king_slime 12` → ui_07_bossbar; `event goblin_army` → ui_08_invasion.
- `kill` → ui_09_death.
- `uiscale 1.5` → ui_10_hud_150; `ui inventory` → ui_11_inventory_150.

Add a step to the ci.yml screenshot-tour job (main and dispatch only) that runs it at --resolution 1280x720 and uploads the shots.

Sweep:
- Remove dead code: old Toast/Announce banner paths, Hud.Bar, CraftingPanel.Describe, InventoryScreen cursor nodes, and leftover `Theme = UiTheme.Theme` lines.
- Run tools/ci/check_file_length.py.
- Confirm F3 metrics gd.hud, gd.inventory_ui, gd.slot_views and gd.tooltip each stay under 0.5 ms at 1080p on the medium preset.
files_modify: .github/workflows/ci.yml — UI tour in the screenshot job
docs/architecture/overview.md, docs/architecture/persistence.md, docs/3D_TERRARIA_MASTER_PLAN.md — UI status and fields
tests: Full CI locally: dotnet build + dotnet test, Strata.Tools manifest --check / validate / coverage, gen_reference.py --check, build_all.py --check, build_ui.py --check, all Scripts/*.cmds SMOKE PASS, menu tour MENU PASS
verification: Run the tour under xvfb + lavapipe at 1280x720 and 1920x1080, then review all 11 shots against the Terraria checklist in the plan (section L)
risks: Lavapipe is slow; keep the tour tiny and on main or manual dispatch only.
